section.content: 本实用新型提供了种二次锂离子电池，包括钢壳、电芯、USB座和帽头部件，电芯的外侧设置有平行于电芯高度方向的第金属带和第二金属带，第金属带和第二金属带的两端均超出电芯，第金属带、第二金属带的端分别与电芯负极端镍带相连接，第金属带的另端连接负极引出导线，第二金属带的另端与钢壳相连接，电芯正极端镍带与正极引出导线相连接，正极引出导线与USB座中PCB板的正极输入端相连接，负极引出导线与USB座中PCB板的负极输入端相连接，电芯以负极端朝下的方式配套置于钢壳内，USB座的外壳配套套在钢壳上端内并部分外露，帽头部件配套卡罩住USB座的USB接头。本实用新型的二次锂离子电池，结构简单，制作方便，稳固性较好。

The utility model provides a kind of secondary lithium battery, including steel shell, battery core, USB and cap head component, the outside setting of battery core is parallel to the first metal tape and the second metal tape of battery core short transverse, the both ends of first metal tape and the second metal tape exceed battery core, first metal tape, one end of second metal tape is connected with battery core negative pole end nickel strap respectively, the other end of first metal tape connects cathode extraction wire, the other end of second metal tape is connected with steel shell, battery core positive terminal nickel strap is connected with positive extraction wire, positive extraction wire is connected with the electrode input end of pcb board in USB, cathode extraction wire is connected with the negative input of pcb board in USB, battery core is matched in such a way that negative pole end is directed downwardly to be placed in steel shell, the mating set of USB shells is in steel shell upper end and part Exposed, the mating card of cap head component covers USB USB joints.The secondary lithium battery of the utility model, structure is simple, easy to make, and stability is preferable.

Secondary lithium batteryTechnical field

The utility model relates to a kind of secondary cell, in particular to a kind of secondary lithium battery.

Background technique

With the development of secondary cell technology, the performance of secondary cell has a quick promotion, while its cost is also substantially Degree decline, especially secondary cell has the characteristics that high-energy density, can be recycled, thus has obtained more and more extensive answer With.Such as the rechargeable lithium ion batteries in secondary cell, have become the main power supply of mobile phone, laptop, camera Battery, and in traditional application field such as remote controler, flashlight, toy etc. of many one-shot batteries, secondary cell is also gradually It is substituted by one-shot battery.

Under normal conditions, secondary cell substitution one-shot battery carry out using, it is necessary first to secondary cell is packed, example Such as using being packed based on after polymerization object lithium-ion electric core, after polymerization object lithium-ion electric core is tucked into shell In, and necessary component such as cap head component is set, cap head component is assembled with shell.Common cell assembling processes, The modes such as crimping, riveting are often relied on to realize the electrical connection of inside battery, it is contemplated that the deviation of battery core size, and fill in steel To guarantee that negative metal band contacts well with steel shell when shell, often negative metal band is folded, so that battery core is packed into steel shell When internal, negative metal band can form a kind of close contact with steel shell inner wall, but this close contact is difficult control, if negative Pole metal tape folding times are excessive, then battery core may be much larger than steel shell internal diameter, electricity plus the maximum overall diameter of negative metal nickel strap Core is then difficult to fill in steel shell；In turn, if negative metal number to be folded is very few, it is easy that battery core, which is matched into steel shell, but It is that negative metal nickel strap just cannot be guaranteed with the contact of steel shell inner wall.And this installation method, big, reproduction that there is deviations Property difference problem, cause assembling after secondary cell functional reliability it is poor, often there are the feelings that poor electric contact can not work Condition.

Therefore, how reasonable electrical connection and mounting process are set, secondary lithium battery contour structures, assembling are processed The operability of technique, one-shot battery use demand plan as a whole optimization, by the Performance And Reliability of secondary lithium battery require with The packaging technology of battery combines, and takes into account cost and efficiency, proposes a high reliability of electrical connection of new secondary lithium battery Solution is assembled, is just very necessary.

Utility model content

The utility model is intended to provide that a kind of structure is simple, novel in design, the preferable secondary lithium of easy to make and stability Ion battery.

The utility model is realized by following scheme:

A kind of secondary lithium battery, including steel shell, battery core, USB and cap head component, described USB includes outside pedestal Shell, pcb board is provided in the base shell, and USB joint, the anode of the USB joint is arranged in the top of the base shell Input terminal is connected with the cathode output end of pcb board, the cathode output end phase of the negative input and pcb board of the USB joint Connection, the USB joint are covered with USB joint shell, and the outside setting of the battery core is parallel to the of battery core short transverse The both ends of one metal tape and the second metal tape, first metal tape and the second metal tape exceed battery core, first metal Band, the second metal tape one end be connected respectively with battery core negative pole end nickel strap, the other end of first metal tape connects cathode The other end of extraction wire, second metal tape is connected with steel shell, the battery core positive terminal nickel strap and positive extraction wire It is connected, the anode extraction wire is connected with the electrode input end of pcb board in USB, the cathode extraction wire and USB The negative input of pcb board is connected in seat, and the battery core is matched in such a way that negative pole end is directed downwardly to be placed in steel shell, the USB The mating set of shell of seat is in steel shell upper end and part is exposed, the mating card of the cap head component cover USB USB joints and The cathode output end of USB joint and the cap head elastic slice on cap head component are in close contact and connect.

To improve the stable connection between each component, between first metal tape and battery core negative pole end nickel strap, second Connection type between metal tape and battery core negative pole end nickel strap, between the second metal tape and steel shell is resistance spot welding, it is described just Between the electrode input end of pcb board between pole extraction wire and battery core positive terminal nickel strap, in positive extraction wire and USB, Company between the negative input of pcb board between cathode extraction wire and the first metal tape, in cathode extraction wire and USB The mode of connecing is soldering.This connection type may make that the internal resistance of secondary lithium battery obtained is smaller and consistency is preferable, It uses resistance spot welding mode between battery core cathode and steel shell to connect, while battery core also passes through the first metal tape, the second metal tape.

Further, there are gaps between first metal tape and the second metal tape.

Under normal circumstances, first metal tape, the second metal tape are nickel strap or nickel plated steel strip, it is contemplated that cost-effectivenes is more It is nickel plated steel strip that number, which is selected,.First metal tape, the width of the second metal tape, thickness can be designed adjustment as needed.

When actual fabrication, the internal structure of cap head component can be designed as needed, as long as meeting USB USB Connector card covers and meets the cathode output end of USB joint and the cap head elastic slice on cap head component is in close contact.USB USB joint is Type A type.

The secondary lithium battery component of the utility model, structure is simple, novel in design, easy to make, it is only necessary to simple Assembly and resistance spot welding installation steps, be not related to folding crimping, bolt, injection molding, the time and effort consumings such as viscose is cementing erector Sequence, internal resistance consistency are preferable.For the utility model by the way of bimetallic strip, the second metal tape is real by resistance spot welding mode It is now electrically connected with steel shell, the first metal tape is realized by cathode extraction wire and is electrically connected with USB, and root between each component Resistance spot welding is respectively adopted according to different characteristics, soldering mode connects so that the stable connection of secondary lithium battery is preferable, Stabilizing circuit access can be still maintained under the conditions of the reliability tests such as vibrating, falling, to meet answering for input or output With demand, guarantee the normal use of battery.
